courses.title: 3D Rendering for Architectural Projects
courses.description: 3D Rendering for Architectural Projects takes you from the basics of 3d rendering to applying it on a realistic Architectural Visualiser scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to project management, enough to use it alongside 3d rendering day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying 3d rendering to a real Architectural Visualiser scenario
Practicing 3d rendering through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to project management
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced 3D Rendering Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced 3D Rendering Techniques is a focused course on 3d rendering for people already working toward a Architectural Visualiser role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying 3d rendering on your own.
